comment: Machine-readable event spec for Real World marketing + funnel analytics. Client emitter: marketing/site/js/analytics.js. Dev sink: marketing/tools/analytics_sink.py. See ANALYTICS.md for the full plan. All events are anonymous (session nonce only, no persistent ids, no cookies).

envelope.event: string — one of the names below
envelope.sid: string — random session nonce from sessionStorage; dies with the tab; NOT a visitor id
envelope.utm: object — utm_source/medium/campaign/content/term + ref, captured at landing, session-scoped
envelope.ref: string|null — referrer HOST only, never the full URL

cta_click.when: click on any element carrying data-rw-event="cta_click"

props.cam: demo camera preset — only on cta=demo-cam: overhead|street|park|director (v96)
props.item: field-card item key — only on cta=demo-fieldcard (v101): deck|parody|routine|fog|wire|quiet|theater|sim

outbound_click.when: click on an external link not otherwise instrumented

scroll_depth.when: page scroll crosses 25/50/75/100% — fires once per mark per page (v22)

engaged_time.when: pagehide — total seconds the page was actually visible (v22)

share_click.when: a share button completes — demo.html share button (v22); pricing.html scene-builder 'Copy a link to this scene' (v97)

props.surface: demo|scene — which share surface; only present on v97+ emitters (demo.js predates it)

price_calc.when: pricing.html estimator control changes, debounced 900ms (v22; +first prop v52)
price_calc.note: carries NO amounts — only which knobs visitors touch; reveals demand for class/duration before checkout exists

props.items: csv of item:qty pairs, e.g. 'compatible:4,event:1'; 'empty' when cleared
props.preset: fog|hour|party|movein|reset|link|none — last preset tapped, 'link' when state arrived via #scene= share hash (v97), or 'none' for manual edits

scene_calc.note: carries NO credit/USD amounts — item mix and quantities only; reveals which bundled scenes visitors reach for

sub_calc.when: pricing.html subscription-breakeven widget control changes, debounced 900ms (v82)

props.camera: bool — camera-director toggle on (priced as the printed ~2 hrs/mo assumption)
props.verdict: none|packs|resident|director|tie — which path the widget computed cheapest

sub_calc.note: carries NO USD/credit totals — usage knobs + which option won only; reveals subscription demand vs à-la-carte preference before checkout exists

request_simulated.when: demo.html request simulator 'File it — simulated' completes (v26; props extended v41)

props.credits: int — quoted cost (lower bound for range-priced actions)
props.surge: bool — surge window shown (exclusive only, v41)

request_simulated.note: local simulation only — no real request is filed; reveals which request types visitors reach for and how the toy screen classifies their wording

press_kit_download.when: click on the kit zip link (data-rw-event on press-kit.html)
press_kit_download.status: PENDING — kit zip link is not yet on press-kit.html (build-press-kit.sh produces it locally; wire data-rw-event when the public link lands)

tour_started.when: onboarding tour begins (game-side; world-v11 onboarding.json analytics_hooks)
tour_started.note: onboarding events carry stage + opted_out ONLY — no per-step dwell/funnel-pressure data (world/onboarding-ui.md §8)

persona_chosen.when: visitor picks the watch|play fork at onboarding S0 (game-side; world-v25 onboarding.json analytics_hooks)
persona_chosen.note: the watch/play split is THE top-of-product metric — which promise visitors came for; persona value only, never identity

handle_set.note: NEVER sends the handle value — presence only

handle_taken_shown.when: the handle step rejects a reserved/taken name (game-side; world-v25)
handle_taken_shown.note: friction signal only — never carries the rejected handle text

first_request_filed.when: the guided first request is filed during onboarding (game-side)

decline_lesson_shown.when: the declined-request refund lesson is shown (game-side; world-v25 S4b)
decline_lesson_shown.note: presence only — measures how often the refund-on-decline teaching moment is reached

returning_session.when: a visitor with prior onboarding state returns (?returning=1 / parked state, game-side; world-v25)
returning_session.note: counts returning sessions, not returning users — no cross-session identity exists by design

review_lesson_shown.when: the human-review lesson is shown before an exclusive/gray-zone ask (game-side; world-v39 S4c review_lesson block)
review_lesson_shown.note: presence only — measures reach of the 'a human reads exclusive asks' teaching moment

review_outcome_seen.when: the scripted review outcome is seen — S4c demo resolves 'not approved — refunded' (game-side; world-v39)

props.outcome: feed-vocab verdict label (approved, or not approved)

review_outcome_seen.note: outcome uses feed-vocabulary values only — never the request text

low_balance_simulated.when: the opt-in low-balance simulation runs and shows 'player session ended' (game-side; world-v39 low_balance_lesson)
low_balance_simulated.note: no amounts — presence + opt-in flag only

handoff_seen.when: a graceful-handoff 'player session ended' state is shown (game-side; world-v39 / session_controls wording)

queue_lesson_shown.when: the queued-ask lesson is shown — S4e teaches that filing while a resource is claimed lands 'queued' at the −15% rate (game-side; world-v53 queue_lesson block)
queue_lesson_shown.note: presence only — measures reach of the queue teaching moment; never carries the request text or the resource name

queue_outcome_seen.when: the scripted queue outcome is seen — S4e demo resolves 'queued request expired before activation' + full auto-refund (game-side; world-v53)
queue_outcome_seen.note: presence + opt-out flag only; the outcome itself is always the scripted expiry — no real request outcomes leak into onboarding analytics

archive_beat_seen.when: tour beat 7 surfaces the feed-archive link under the Wire stream (game-side; world-v53 archive_beat block — merge target needs a feed-archive anchor on the real Wire)
archive_beat_seen.note: measures discovery of the history surface; stage + opt-out only

band_declared.when: account picks an age band at onboarding S2a (game-side; world-v67 eligibility layer — §30)
band_declared.note: eligibility is not funnel data — the band VALUE is never a prop (world-v67 §35); stage + opt-out only

ads_line_shown.when: the adults-only §2.7 sponsored-message line renders on the wallet card (game-side; world-v67 §33 — structural guard: band==='adult' only)
ads_line_shown.note: counts exposure of the opt-in ad affordance; its absence for teen/na/u13/unset bands is by construction, not an event

ad_demo_viewed.when: adult-band account watches one demo sponsored message for +2 cr, capped 5/day (game-side; world-v67 §33)
ad_demo_viewed.note: opt-in rewarded path only — never pre-roll/mid-session; no countdown/cap-pressure props

hired_return.when: post-hire return via ?hired=1 deep link → first-day card S6 (game-side; world-v39 hired_return block)
hired_return.note: counts hire-return sessions; no identity props — merge target is create.html → onboarding.html?hired=1

watch_start.when: spectator surface first rendered — demo.js emits this today on demo.html (mode=fallback until the live embed lands); the game embed will emit it with source=direct|embed

props.mode: live|fallback — real embed vs static-capture fallback

watch_start.status: LIVE on demo.html via site/js/demo.js (v66 — spec updated to match the shipped emitter); live spectator embed still PENDING game build

request_submitted.when: a viewer files a world request (game-side event; spec only)

character_created.when: a viewer hires/creates a character (game-side event; spec only)

community_join.when: click on the community invite link (community.html / recap posts)
community_join.status: PENDING — invite link is a placeholder until the server exists (COMMUNITY-FUNNEL.md §3); wire data-rw-event="community_join" onto the real link at go time
community_join.note: join INTENT only — actual Discord joins are counted server-side, manually (community/first-100.md §4: no cross-platform tracking)

recap_open.when: a 'This Week on the Block' recap post is opened (devlog/blog permalink)
recap_open.status: PENDING — recap permalink surface exists post-launch
recap_open.note: Stage 1→2 retention metric (COMMUNITY-FUNNEL.md §1); never carries reader identity

watch_party_rsvp.when: a member reacts/RSVPs to a watch-party announcement (Discord-side)
watch_party_rsvp.status: PENDING — Discord-side, manual count at launch (community/watch-party-playbook.md §3)
watch_party_rsvp.note: no per-member data — a count, not a list

privacy.ip_storage: server-side daily-rotating hash only (salt + IP + UA + date); raw IPs never stored — implemented in analytics_sink.py --uniques (v81)
